title: Allan Cunningham Monument — Cunningham’s Gap

terrainReference.basis: Native memorial point selected before source-field acquisition and all floor/main-section/geometry choices; provider-relative terrain datum, no surveyed contact.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap named Allan Cunningham memorial node1542097343, independently matched to primary heritage-register site650225 and Wikipedia Q130550538; native node has no Wikidata tag and provides a point, not a measured outline.
mapIdentity.scope: Whole Allan Cunningham Monument at Cunningham’s Gap: stone obelisk/cairn, integral stepped cement-rendered base, three south-facing marble plaques and its low post-and-single-rail enclosure. Forest, highway, natural mountain, tourist shelter and later unrelated monuments are excluded. A primary-text reconstruction of the simple structure; main height/base dimensions follow the Queensland heritage authority. Taper, step divisions, stone pattern, plaque sizes, enclosure size and small fittings are bounded estimates. No archive photograph used or photographic fidelity claimed.

note: Primary authority gives height5m/base3x3m. Floor0 fixed at original field contact after acquisition. Taper, step divisions, plaques and fence dimensions are bounded reconstruction estimates, not taken from archive imagery.
